sectionBreaks.before:
建造房屋、桥梁、飞机、汽车和轮船时，需要了解混凝土、钢、塑料等材料的强度。
仅知道小形变时的刚度还不够，还要了解较大形变、卸载以及最终破坏时的行为。
这些性质主要通过针对具体材料、样品和加载条件的实验获得。
sectionBreaks.after:
**比例极限和弹性极限**
材料可以通过拉伸或压缩实验检验；
本节随后讨论一类延性样品的单轴拉伸示意，拉伸与压缩的曲线不必相同。

sectionBreaks.before: 两者的差值并不是所有样品都相同的固定比例。
sectionBreaks.after:
**强度极限和安全系数**
对本节图示的这类材料，超过弹性极限后卸去负载，样品虽然会缩短一部分，却可能留下不能恢复的伸长。
卸载后保留下来的永久形变称为塑性形变，应与可以恢复的弹性部分区分。

sectionBreaks.before:
原书“不增加外界负载，样品被拉得很长”的描述不能理解为断裂阶段的拉力必须严格不变。
强度极限和曲线形状随材料、加工状态及测试条件变化，脆性材料不一定经历同样的屈服、硬化和颈缩过程。
sectionBreaks.after:
为了留出强度裕量，本节把结构的许用应力 $\sigma_{\text{许用}}$ 取在材料强度极限以下。
原书按强度极限与许用应力的比值定义安全系数：
$n=\frac{\sigma_{\text{极限}}}{\sigma_{\text{许用}}}$。

coverage.topic: Source buildings/bridges/aircraft/cars/ships and concrete/steel/plastics strength topics; experiments tied to samples and loading, stiffness distinct from failure.

Tension/compression test topic retained; fig88 explicitly a ductile tensile engineering-stress versus engineering-strain example, initial area and initial gauge length, source sigma/epsilon/OA and proportional limit retained.
AB nonlinearity versus recoverability; source0.1% residual-strain elastic-limit convention and one-percent difference retained as book/sample-conditioned, not universal exact definitions.
Recoverable unloading plus permanent plastic deformation in the represented material; no universal post-limit sequence.
C/CD yield plateau and source fluidity explanation retained as plastic solid yielding under appropriate loading, not liquid phase or an all-material plateau.

E maximum, K fracture and source sigma-limit preserved; strain hardening then necking, engineering-stress/force decrease distinguished from true stress, finite-load claim corrected in prose without new math.
Original allowable-stress symbol and safety-factor ratio6-6 unchanged; working stress/allowable margin does not alone prove global safety.
Source1.7..10 range preserved as source-context example, not universal/current design standard; static/dynamic/material/hazard factors and allowable-stress role preserved.
